question: Narayana Guru, a social reformer who led a massive movement against the discrimination of the lower castes, was from the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Narayana Guru** was one of the most prominent social reformers from the state of **Kerala**. He was born in **Chempazhanthy, Kerala**, in **1856** and worked tirelessly against caste-based discrimination.
 
• He was a **spiritual leader**, philosopher, and social reformer who strongly opposed the rigid caste system prevalent in society during his time. He also emphasized the importance of **education** and equality.
 
• Narayana Guru's philosophy was based on the principles of **oneness of humanity** and the abolition of caste discrimination. He propagated the idea of "One Caste, One Religion, One God for All."
 
• He established several temples in Kerala, which were open to people from all castes, challenging the orthodox Hindu tradition of restricting lower castes from entering temples. This was a significant step in promoting equality.
